affected_predicate.description: a qualifying November invoice or receipt PDF is copied into Finance/invoice

competing_trace_defects.description: The agent completed while Finance/invoice visibly showed “No items,” without any observed paste action after entering the folder.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the device root is visibly open and the action correctly enters Finance. The reused navigation claim therefore causes no visible harmful mechanism. Later, the agent creates and enters invoice but the destination visibly remains empty when it completes.

summary: The reused stale navigation claim was harmless at its target; an independently observable later false completion occurred with the destination folder empty.
